notes.title: Do not go gentle into that good night，Game is pulished on 9.27
notes.notes: [p]Yes, I have decided that my independently developed work 'She Graduated' will be officially launched on Steam at 0:00 on September 27th, with an original price of 10 yuan. After its first release, it will only cost 8 yuan.[/p][p]Solo make game, tough at the beginning, tough in the middle, and tough at the end. No matter how long the journey, there will eventually be an end, either giving up, failing, or reaching the end of the road, finally witnessing the unknown scenery.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]NOTICE:[/u][/b][u] Dive into our campus visual novel—a lagre text-based adventure! The English version will launch on Steam months after the Chinese release. Thank you for understanding as we perfect the localization![/u][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43109012/6bcf0182f2dd591a854ac811c3741205b801900c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Do not go gentle into that good night,[/p][p]Old age should burn and rave at close of day;[/p][p]Rage, rage against the dying of the light.[/p][p]——Dylan Thomas[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Here comes Steam Summer Next Fest! The game is about to be released!!!
notes.notes: [p]These days are the days of China's college entrance examination, and coincidentally, the theme of "graduation" also echoes with my game (although mine is about college graduation). Time flies a long time has passed since the store page was released, and I have overcome various challenges in game-making, with the production now entering the final stages. If all goes well, the game is expected to be released in July.[/p][p][/p][p]I truly apologize for making all my expecting friends wait so long. Mainly due to my personal capabilities and developing it in my spare time, I hope this ordinary game won't disappoint everyone when it's released. This is also my first time participating in the Next Fest. Whether you pass by or come to experience it, thank you so much for stopping by.[/p][p][/p][p]In short, Happy Graduation![/p]

notes.title: Demo is now available! Welcome to play~
notes.notes:
大家好，我是无有人，一个普通人。
很高兴与各位玩家见面，《她毕业了》是我的第一款游戏，试图再现我的大学时光。
我知道这款游戏十分普通，但还是希望你能够喜欢它。

现在已公布试玩版，内容占到总体的50~70%，时长约1-3小时（但愿没什么bug）。
如果启动不了，可以关闭杀毒软件重新安装再试一下或从电脑文件夹进入游戏。

总之，感兴趣的朋友可以添加一下愿望单，也可以直接在评论区留下任何想法或建议，这对我都是莫大的鼓励与支持。
祝屏幕前的你生活愉快，万事如意。

游玩之后，如果你能不吝抽出一点时间留下你的想法或建议，我想她一定会很高兴的，谢谢。
